t: Forging a 'Magic Wand': The Great Stuffing of Pipulate
s: This technical journal chronicles refactoring Pipulate from a web-server-dependent tool to a self-contained, importable library for Jupyter Notebooks, focusing on dependency injection via FastHTML's fastlite and Nix for independence.
sub: Transforming Pipulate into a self-contained Jupyter Notebook library
Dependency injection using fastlite instead of fast_app
Leveraging Nix for infrastructure independence and future-proofing
Resolving import nuances in JupyterLab by resetting the kernel
